properties.description:
EZ PERMIT STANDARDS WINDOWS & DOORS For Replacement of Exterior Windows & Doors without submitting plans by meeting the Conditions and Design Limitations below. Any deviations from this permit standard will result in permit revocation.

STATEMENT OF WORK: 

FIBER CABLING:

•	Provide labor to install 288-strand singlemode non-armored ribbon fiber optic cable from the Head End to Comm Rooms 3.12.04, 3.37.03, 5.37.04, 5.08.03, 5.22.04 and North Tunnell IDF.
•	Provide labor to install of 6-strand fiber/conductor composite cable from Comm Rooms 3.12.04, 3.37.03, 5.37.04, 5.08.03, 5.22.04 and North Tunnell IDF as required out to twenty-seven (27) remote locations.  
•	Provide labor to install the following equipment as required to facilitate fiber installation/termination:

DESCRIPTION	QTY
4RU rack mount enclosure (HE)	6
4RU rack mount enclosure (IDF)	12
24f SM polimods (HE)	8
24f SM polimods (IDF's)	14
6f or 12f SM polimods (Nodes)	27
Fiber splice ribbon - (27) 6 strand ribbons (HE side of the 288 strand)	162
Fiber splice ribbon - (54) 6 strand ribbons (IDF side of the 288 strand) (IDF side of the 6 strand composite)	324
Fiber splice ribbon - (27) 6 strand ribbons (Node side of the 6 strand composite)	162

•	Provide labor and material to label cables, panels and enclosures.
•	Provide labor to test all fiber strands.
•	Provide labor to install one (1) optical splicing and distribution outdoor fiber enclosures at each of twenty-seven (27) node ends.


PATHWAYS & FIRESTOP:

•	Provide labor to install j-hooks and beam clamps or mounting accessories as required to facilitate cable distribution. 
•	Provide labor to seal all through penetrations of fire rated walls for telecommunications use to maintain necessary fire ratings. 


HEAD END RELOCATION:

•	Provide labor to relocate six (6) 288-strand fiber optic cables from temporary location to permanent location.
•	Provide labor to install enclosures, polimods and splice ribbons as required to facilitate relocation.

tapered crickets giving the entire system an minimum R-value of 30. Install .090
black EPDM adhered in Cav-Grip III.

copings will remain and flashing will terminate below, leaving the look of the
building the same.

properties.metadescription:
General Permit Minor. EZ Roof Covering Replacement. **Existing Philadelphia Historic Property** 
For repair / replacement of roof covering(s) on existing roof(s) in accordance with the attached EZ Permit Re-Roofing Standard. Failure to comply with the attached EZ Permit Re-Roofing Standard shall result in revocation of this permit.  *No work to the windows and / or exterior doors as part of this permit per the PHC approval.* 

EPDM Re-roof (4100sf): Tear off existing roof to existing metal deck. Install
self-adhered vapor barrier to metal deck. Install 2 layers of 2.5" insulation. The
first layer is fastened with 4" screws. The second layer is adhered in Flexible
FAST. Install 1/2" hy density polyiso coverboard adhered in Flexible FAST, plus
tapered crickets giving the entire system an minimum R-value of 30. Install .090
black EPDM adhered in Cav-Grip III.
Metal copings will be removed and replaced where existing. Existing Cast stone
copings will remain and flashing will terminate below, leaving the look of the
building the same.
NOTE: The upper roof was an addition added in the past 20 years so. Completed. 3819-31 CHESTNUT ST

Each system will operate at an airflow rate of 1,200–1,400 CFM, in line with the rule of ~400 CFM per ton of cooling. Units will be selected with SEER2 ratings between 15 and 18 for cooling efficiency and HSPF2 ratings between 9 and 10 for heating efficiency, meeting or exceeding current Pennsylvania energy code requirements.

The system will distribute conditioned air through properly sized ductwork with supply and return registers per room to maintain balanced airflow, indoor comfort, and compliance with local codes.

properties.description:
EZ PERMIT SECURITY GATES & GRILLS - For the Installation of Security Gates & Grills as per attached standards. Deviations from these standards require submission of construction and site plans.

• EZ permit process shall not be applicable to buildings listed as historic as established by the Philadelphia Historical Commission. 
• All security gates & grills used for commercial purposes in Designated Center City, Historic, or Specified Neighborhood Commercial Areas (as specified in the Philadelphia Property Maintenance Code, Section PM803.1) shall allow for a minimum substantial front face visibility surface area openness of 75% at all times. 

• Installation of security gates/grills at main exits are permitted only in Group B, F, M and S occupancies. Gate/grill installed at main exits must be openable from the inside without the use of a key or special knowledge or effort during periods that the space is occupied. (B-1010.1.4.5) Note that the main exit(s) are identified as required exit(s) that are readily identifiable as a primary point of ingress and egress by building occupants. • Not more than 50% of the required exits or exit access doorways shall be equipped with horizontal or vertical sliding security grills. (B-1005.5) • Grills to remain secured in the full-open position during the period of occupancy by the general public. • Installation of new security gates/grills shall not obstruct egress path of other tenants, property owners or occupants at shared easements or entryways. (B-1010.1.4.5) 

• Minimum Height above Footway: 7’-0” Installation • Installation as per manufacturer’s specifications and listing. • Anchoring of security gates & grills shall be made to the front face of building with appropriate noncorrosive fasteners as per manufacturer’s instructions. • Complete manufacturer’s installation instructions to be on site for inspector. 

For the installation of one security gate to comply with the violation CF-2025-024445.
